Subject: Hosted API evaluation — quick walkthrough request

Hi Jordan,

I signed up for the Redwood Hosted API earlier this week (used the sandbox) and I
was wondering if we could do a 30-minute walkthrough focused on inference latency and
embedding batch performance. We're a small team evaluating a search + summarization
flow and I'd like to see a short demo plus best-practice tips for reducing per-token
costs.

We're based in PST and our preferred windows are mornings (9–11am) next week. We'll
have two engineers and myself on the call. Attached is a small screenshot of our
request flow and an example payload.

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Head of ML, Acme Commerce
priya.sharma@acme-commerce.com

We can definitely run a focused 30-minute session. I have the following valid
slots next week in your morning window (PST):
- Tue 27 Jul, 9:30–10:00am PT
- Wed 28 Jul, 10:00–10:30am PT
- Thu 29 Jul, 9:00–9:30am PT

Would any of those work? If not, tell me a specific day/time and I'll confirm.

Quick housekeeping so we make the most of 30 minutes:
- Who will join (names + roles) — you mentioned two engineers which is perfect.
- Are you primarily interested in generative latency or embeddings throughput?
- Any non-disclosure constraints?

Pre-reads: a short sandbox guide: https://redwood.ai/sandbox-quickstart (public)
I also dropped in a pre-auth link to a temporary sandbox token if you'd like to
bring a request during the call.

I'll cc Jordan (solutions engineer) who can lead the demo if you want deeper
architecture questions answered.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
SDR, Redwood Inference
